paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of Orlah, chapter 1; the passage implies that he lived in the time of R' Yose, R' Yonah’s colleague.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: רפ״א gives beginning of chapter 1, not end. The corpus is unspecified; no Mishnah/Yerushalmi suggestion is independently verified.

מתיא is Matya rather than Mattai. Min de-Batra’ah remains an unexplained transliterated designation; of-the-later-ones is only a possible lexical gloss, not a dated generation or place identification.
Yose is the colleague of Yonah; contemporaneity remains Hyman’s inference, not independent chronology. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
